adopted_edits.text: ■ 《消防设备管理法施行规则》[别纸第2号格式]
依照《消防设备管理法施行令》第13条及同法施行规则第10条规定，
现颁发如下消防设备认证书。

rationale.A25277-zh-00001: 소방장비관리법 시행규칙 [별지 제2호서식]: preserve law, implementing rule and annex form number.
rationale.A25277-zh-00003: 소방장비인증서: explicitly a certification certificate, not merely a device document.
rationale.A25277-zh-00004: 인증사업자: certified business operator, not the organization operating certification services.
rationale.A25277-zh-00005: 상호(회사명): both trade name and company name included.
rationale.A25277-zh-00008: 「소방장비관리법 시행령」 제13조 및 같은 법 시행규칙 제10조; exact governing document names and numbered citations.
rationale.A25277-zh-00009: 다음과 같이 소방장비 인증서를 발급합니다; completes split issuance sentence, replaces untranslated punctuation.

note: First previously staged but quality-unconfirmed certificate-form corrections compared with full Korean A25277 form and split sentence. Existing A25276 and law source hashes preserved; no new unique 1162-row coverage or COMPLETE receipt.
